tina_pm: Morning — quick rollcall on action items from the 3/10 outage. Postmortem is here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5234. I pasted the action list below — please confirm owner + firm due date or say reassign. If you have blockers, flag them now so we can escalate.

Actions (from the doc):
• A1 fix-request-batching-race — owner: @ben_eng — proposed due: 2026-03-23
• A2 kv-cache-ttl-regen — owner: @li_infra — proposed due: 2026-03-19
• A3 update-fallback-routing + canary policy — owner: @maria_sre — proposed due: 2026-03-22
• A4 customer-comms-draft + send — owner: @samir_reliability — proposed due: 2026-03-17

Please reply with either "confirmed", a new date, or who to reassign to. Target: lock dates by EOD today. :eyes:

ben_eng: I can take A1. PR is already up (#8421) but still running integration/stability tests. Need two extra days — can do 2026-03-25. Will link test logs when green. :+1:

li_infra: Heads up - infra maintenance window this week means I can't finish A2 by 3/19. Can move to 2026-03-24. Also blocked on storage-team review (STG-1103). Pinging @storage-team.

maria_sre: Confirmed for A3 on 2026-03-22. Will coordinate canary windows with infra. Need someone from runtime to approve the fallback config (cc @ben_eng for any model-side changes).

samir_reliability: I can draft customer comms (A4) by 2026-03-17 AM, but legal needs to review before send. Request legal review by EOD 3/16 — pinging legal via ticket. If legal slips, can hold send until 3/18.

ops-bot: Created tickets for each action: INF-A1 (#8421), INF-A2 (STG-1103), INF-A3 (#8435), INF-A4 (COMMS-210). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-A1 etc.

ben_eng: noting dependency for A1 — test infra needs an extra 4GB GPU reservation; I've filed infra request in STG-1104. If that isn't granted by 3/21 we should re-evaluate the date.

tina_pm: thanks — summary of accepted updates: A1 @ben_eng -> 2026-03-25 (blocked until STG-1104 grant), A2 @li_infra -> 2026-03-24 (blocked on STG-1103), A3 @maria_sre -> 2026-03-22, A4 @samir_reliability -> 2026-03-17 (pending legal). I'll escalate STG tickets with infra/legal owners if we don't have confirmation by EOD local today. If anyone needs reassignment, say so now. :raised_hand:
